about: The Workbench icons of the Micropolis drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out <dir> (amiga/Makefile.amigaos runs it). The art is the game's own tool palette: the residential zone (MicropolisCore content/micropolis/images/tool_residential.png) for the program and the badge, the commercial zone (tool_commercial.png) for cities. Micropolis-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, installed as Micropolis.info beside it. Data.info is the icon of every subdrawer. City.info goes on CITY.CTY and every bundled city, and as icons/def_city.info it is the icon the game gives each city it saves, its default tool then set to the program; CityIn.info is the bundled cities' copy, whose default tool is one drawer up.
